## Negative SVA tests

Each case breaks one property by forcing a signal or driving illegal stimulus and expects that assertion to fire. No case: `asm_A06_w_inputs_known` (two-state simulator: inputs are never X), `asm_A06_r_inputs_known` (two-state simulator: inputs are never X). Per-case detail: `docs/sva_negative_tests.md`.

## Structural CDC

Rules (`common/scripts/cdc_check.py`, domains and waivers in `constraints/cdc.toml`): R1 no logic on a crossing, R2 the first synchronizer stage feeds only the second, R3 each stage is reset in its destination domain. R4 notes multi-bit synchronizers, which are safe only for gray-coded sources (checked by the F09 properties, not structurally).

- Waived R1: memory mem (wclk) -> output rdata (rclk): logic between source and destination (reason: memory read path: data qualified by the synchronized pointers (spec §6, F14); vplan §8)
- Note R4: 5-bit synchronizer wptr -> rq1_wptr: safe only if the source changes at most one bit per source edge (not checked structurally)
- Note R4: 5-bit synchronizer rptr -> wq1_rptr: safe only if the source changes at most one bit per source edge (not checked structurally)
